name: license-manager-user-subscriptions
description: With License Manager, you can create user-based subscriptions to utilize licensed software with a per user subscription fee on Amazon EC2 instances.

subcommands.name: associate-user
subcommands.description: Associates the user to an EC2 instance to utilize user-based subscriptions.

subcommands.name: create-license-server-endpoint
subcommands.description: Creates a network endpoint for the Remote Desktop Services (RDS) license server.

subcommands.name: deregister-identity-provider
subcommands.description: Deregisters the Active Directory identity provider from License Manager user-based subscriptions.

subcommands.name: disassociate-user
subcommands.description: Disassociates the user from an EC2 instance providing user-based subscriptions.

subcommands.name: list-identity-providers
subcommands.description: Lists the Active Directory identity providers for user-based subscriptions.

subcommands.name: list-instances
subcommands.description: Lists the EC2 instances providing user-based subscriptions.

subcommands.name: list-license-server-endpoints
subcommands.description: List the Remote Desktop Services (RDS) License Server endpoints

subcommands.name: list-product-subscriptions
subcommands.description: Lists the user-based subscription products available from an identity provider.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns the list of tags for the specified resource.

subcommands.name: list-user-associations
subcommands.description: Lists user associations for an identity provider.

subcommands.name: register-identity-provider
subcommands.description: Registers an identity provider for user-based subscriptions.

subcommands.name: start-product-subscription
subcommands.description: Starts a product subscription for a user with the specified identity provider.

subcommands.name: stop-product-subscription
subcommands.description: Stops a product subscription for a user with the specified identity provider.

subcommands.name: update-identity-provider-settings
subcommands.description: Updates additional product configuration settings for the registered identity provider.
